If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
88: the design is 79% of the free core before the flow adds its buffers.

A micro tile is 2999 um2 of core. The PDK's list of cells that synthesis may not use (no_synth.cells) holds every drive-strength-1 gate and flop, so that the netlist starts at strength 2 and the resizer has room: on this tile that is a third of the area. src/no_synth.cells is the PDK's list (open_pdks 8afc834) without the _1 gates and dfxtp_1; the resizer still upsizes where timing asks.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz. 39 ns: the 25.175 MHz VGA pixel clock (39.72 ns).
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.

0.04 / 0.03 (local run t5): the worst hold slack before any repair is +0.05 ns over LibreLane's 0.25 ns clock uncertainty; the default 0.1 margin bought 16 delay cells (160 um2, 5% of the tile) and took the router from 8 iterations to 30.
A clock tree for 39 flops within 65 um: one sink cluster and small buffers (five clkbuf_16 by default, 125 um2; ten clkbuf_4, 75 um2, with these).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
